findings.title: undoRedoThunks — multi-slice behavior with zero direct tests

findings.what_is_wrong: undoRedoThunks.ts:22-56 (performUndo/performRedo) coordinates two slices (undoRedoSlice + tierSlice); the snapshot round-trip is not tested anywhere in packages/state/test/. undoRedoSlice.test.ts does not exist.
findings.leverage_impact: Without tests, every future change to undoRedoThunks carries blind regression risk.
findings.locality_impact: Bug surface for undo/redo spreads across two slice reducers and one thunk file with no test boundary.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Primary user feature with zero unit test coverage at the thunk interface.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add packages/state/test/undoRedoThunks.test.ts. Test: captureSnapshot pushes snapshot; performUndo restores prior state; performRedo restores undone state; new action after undo clears future. Use real store instance (same pattern as importJSON.test.ts).

builder_notes.pattern: Ambient browser globals in Redux middleware
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Test output shows 'Cannot log after tests are done' with stack trace pointing to a setTimeout callback in middleware. The global is accessed inside the timer, which fires after Jest teardown.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Guard every localStorage/sessionStorage access with if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return; at the top of each exported function AND at the top of any timer callback that accesses the global.
builder_notes.stack_example: persistenceMiddleware.ts:23: if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return; inside the setTimeout callback before store.getState().

builder_notes.pattern: Cross-slice thunks with no integration test
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A thunk dispatches to two different slice reducers; the test suite covers each slice independently but has no test exercising the combined round-trip.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For every thunk spanning 2+ slices, add one integration test using a real store instance that asserts the final state across both slices.
builder_notes.stack_example: undoRedoThunks.ts: captureSnapshot → performUndo → performRedo; test should check state.undoRedo.past, state.undoRedo.future, AND state.tier.tiers after each call.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A React page component over ~300 LOC with 5+ useState calls for independent concerns and 3+ useEffect calls.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Each self-contained behavior becomes one custom hook named use<Behavior>. The page component becomes a coordinator.
builder_notes.stack_example: TierBoardPage.tsx:139-154 URL share import useEffect — no local state dependencies; extracting to useShareImport() costs ~15 lines and zero blast radius.

narrative: Good app, place but not win yet. Loop 6 resolves F-002: persistenceMiddleware.ts now guards all 4 localStorage call sites, eliminating the test-environment crash and warning. Framework idioms and credibility each move up one point from the closed gap. Full suite stays green at 17/84. Two structural gaps remain: undoRedoThunks zero unit tests (primary user feature, blind CI regression risk — next loop Priority 1) and TierBoardPage.tsx at 757 LOC (god-component — Priority 2). Concurrency trustworthy. Runtime ownership honest. The guard fix is idiomatic and minimal.
